propositions: Cloud transport has four distinct 429 retry behaviours across multiple seams (direct REST, bare urlopen, ACLI subprocess, dispatch wrapper) requiring per-layer enumeration and assertion rather than uniform coverage
Every mutating Cloud transport member must be explicitly classified by both transport seam and dispatch level to prevent undocumented retries being introduced by omission in new mutations
Cloud config validation lacks DC-level hardening: non-HTTPS URLs are not rejected, missing credentials do not fail loudly, and resolved-status names are hardcoded rather than configurable

Cloud's probe uses a hardcoded resolved-status set (Resolved/Done/Cancelled) while DC threads the value from settings; parity requires a runtime config hook unless Cloud deployments cannot use non-standard workflow state names
DC user-search method degradation to string matching must be pinned in tests to prevent accidental renames breaking the fallback path silently
Each new test requires mutation checking via concrete perturbation demonstrating the assertion would fail if the tested behaviour were removed or inverted
